/bin/bash -lc "cp src/PriorityFilter.tsx src/UnreadFilter.tsx
python3 - <<'PY'
p='src/UnreadFilter.tsx'
s=open(p).read().replace('PriorityFilter','UnreadFilter').replace('data-testid=\"priority-filter\"','data-testid=\"unread-filter\"').replace('Priority only','Unread only')
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='src/App.tsx'
s=open(p).read().replace(\"import { PriorityFilter } from './PriorityFilter'\", \"import { PriorityFilter } from './PriorityFilter'\\nimport { UnreadFilter } from './UnreadFilter'\")
s=s.replace('  const [priorityOnly, setPriorityOnly] = useState(false)', '  const [priorityOnly, setPriorityOnly] = useState(false)\\n  const [unreadOnly, setUnreadOnly] = useState(false)')
s=s.replace('          <button\\n', '          <UnreadFilter\\n            active={unreadOnly}\\n            onToggle={() => setUnreadOnly((value) => "'!value)}'"\\n          />\\n          <button\\n', 1)
s=s.replace(\"          {priorityOnly ? ' Priority messages only.' : ''}\", \"          {priorityOnly ? ' Priority messages only.' : ''}\\n          {unreadOnly ? ' Unread messages only.' : ''}\")
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
npm run check"
